question.question:
Your school is organising a 'No Plastic Bags' campaign. As the secretary of the Environmental Club, you have read the notice from the Organising Committee asking for suggestions. Write a formal letter to the Principal of SMK Seri Bahagia giving your suggestions for the campaign.

In your letter, include the following points:
• suggest activities that can be carried out during the campaign week
• explain how students can be encouraged to bring their own bags
• state the benefits of reducing the use of plastic bags

Write your letter in about 150 words or more. [35 marks]
question.stimulus:
NOTICE
SMK SERI BAHAGIA

'NO PLASTIC BAGS' CAMPAIGN

Date: 5 – 9 August

Our school will launch a week-long 'No Plastic Bags' campaign. We would like students to share ideas on how the school can reduce the use of plastic bags. Please send your suggestions to the Principal. Your ideas will help us plan the campaign activities.

Thank you.
The Organising Committee
question.kbat_level: Create (Application and Synthesis of ideas into a formal written product)
question.model_answer:
SMK Seri Bahagia,
Jalan Bunga Raya,
43000 Kajang,
Selangor.

1 August 20XX

The Principal,
SMK Seri Bahagia,
Jalan Bunga Raya,
43000 Kajang,
Selangor.

Dear Sir,

Suggestions for the 'No Plastic Bags' Campaign

I am writing on behalf of the Environmental Club to offer some suggestions for the 'No Plastic Bags' campaign that will be held from 5 to 9 August.

Firstly, we suggest that several activities be carried out during the campaign week. We could hold a poster-design competition and a short talk during assembly to explain why plastic bags are harmful. In addition, the canteen could stop giving out plastic bags and use paper bags instead for one week so that students can experience the difference.

Secondly, to encourage students to bring their own bags, the school could give a small reward such as a stamp or a merit point to students who use reusable bags every day. We could also display a chart in each class to show which class uses the fewest plastic bags, and announce the winning class at the end of the week. This friendly competition would motivate students to take part.

Finally, reducing the use of plastic bags brings many benefits. Plastic bags take hundreds of years to break down and often end up in rivers and drains, causing floods. By using fewer plastic bags, we protect wildlife and keep our environment clean for future generations.

We hope these suggestions will be useful and we look forward to helping with the campaign.

Thank you.

Yours faithfully,

(Alia binti Ahmad)
Secretary,
Environmental Club
question.illustrative_notes: This is a formal letter to a principal, so use a polite, respectful register and the correct formal letter layout (sender's address, date, recipient's address, salutation, subject line, body, closing). Plan three clear paragraphs, one for each bullet point, and develop each with reasons, examples or suggestions rather than just mentioning it. Keep a consistent formal tone and link your ideas with appropriate connectors.

marking_rubric_bands.descriptors: Format correct. All content points covered and developed. Accurate, varied, appropriately registered language.
Format mostly correct. Content points covered with some development. Generally accurate language with some errors.
Format partly correct. Some content points missing or only mentioned. Errors sometimes block meaning.
Format wrong or absent. Few or no content points. Frequent errors; may be largely off-task.

question.question:
You are the secretary of the English Language Society of SMK Taman Mutiara. You have been asked to write a formal letter to the Principal, Datin Azizah binti Rahman, to seek approval for the proposed one-day educational trip to Kuala Lumpur as described in the notice above.

Write your letter covering the following points:

• Explain the benefits of the educational trip for the members
• Suggest TWO additional activities that could be carried out during the trip
• Describe the safety measures that will be taken to protect all participants

Write your letter in about 150 words or more. [35 marks]
question.stimulus:
NOTICE

SMK TAMAN MUTIARA
ENGLISH LANGUAGE SOCIETY

Proposed Educational Trip: Kuala Lumpur

Dear members,

Following our recent meeting, the English Language Society is planning a one-day educational trip to Kuala Lumpur during the coming school holidays. As the secretary, I have been asked to write to the Principal to seek approval for this trip.

Details discussed so far:
• Date: Saturday, 15 March (school holidays)
• Venue: Petrosains Discovery Centre and the National Library
• Participants: 40 members and 4 teachers
• Activities: Science and English learning workshops, a reading session
• Estimated cost per student: RM45 (including bus fare and entrance fees)

The Principal has requested a formal letter explaining why the trip is beneficial and how we will ensure the safety of all participants. Please include your suggestions for two additional activities and any other information that would help the Principal make a decision.

Thank you.

Secretary,
English Language Society
question.model_answer:
SMK Taman Mutiara,
Jalan Mutiara 3,
43000 Kajang,
Selangor Darul Ehsan.

15 February 2025

Datin Azizah binti Rahman,
Principal,
SMK Taman Mutiara,
Jalan Mutiara 3,
43000 Kajang,
Selangor Darul Ehsan.

Dear Datin Azizah,

APPLICATION FOR APPROVAL OF A ONE-DAY EDUCATIONAL TRIP TO KUALA LUMPUR

I am writing on behalf of the English Language Society to seek your approval for a one-day educational trip to Kuala Lumpur on Saturday, 15 March, during the school holidays. Forty members and four teachers will take part.

We believe this trip will greatly benefit our members. The workshops at Petrosains Discovery Centre and the National Library will strengthen their English communication skills and widen their general knowledge. Furthermore, visiting these places will encourage our students to read more and develop a lifelong interest in learning.

Besides the planned workshops, we would like to suggest two additional activities. First, a treasure hunt at the National Library, which would make reading fun and build teamwork. Second, a short public-speaking session at Petrosains, where members can present what they have learnt during the day.

The safety of all participants is our top priority. We will ensure a ratio of one teacher to every ten students, and all members must follow a buddy system at all times. Attendance will be taken at every checkpoint, and parents will be informed of our itinerary in advance. A first-aid kit will also be available, and students with medical conditions will be closely monitored.

The estimated cost is RM45 per student, which covers bus fare and entrance fees. We sincerely hope you will approve this trip as it promises to be an enriching experience for our members. We look forward to your favourable reply.

Thank you.

Yours faithfully,

________________
(Amirah binti Zulkifli)
Secretary,
English Language Society
question.illustrative_notes: This is a directed writing task requiring a formal letter to a principal. Use the standard formal letter format: sender's address, date, recipient's address, salutation, subject line, body paragraphs, closing and signature. Write in a polite, formal register and develop each of the three content points into its own paragraph, using the stimulus details (e.g., the requested date, venue, number of participants, and activities) to make your suggestions specific and convincing.

marking_rubric_bands.descriptors: Format correct. All content points covered and developed. Accurate, varied, appropriately registered language.
Format mostly correct. Content points covered with some development. Generally accurate language with some errors.
Format partly correct. Some content points missing or only mentioned. Errors sometimes block meaning.
Format wrong or absent. Few or no content points. Frequent errors; may be largely off-task.

question.question: Discuss the importance of maintaining a balanced nature and explain the roles humans play in ensuring the sustainability of living things. [10 marks]
question.stimulus: Based on the following information: Ecosystems rely on the interdependence among living organisms and their environment to create a balanced nature. Current environmental challenges require humans to take an active role in ensuring the sustainability of biodiversity and the continuity of life.
question.model_answer:
Maintaining a balanced nature is essential for the continuity of life on Earth. Biodiversity provides the foundation for ecosystems where all organisms exist in a state of interdependence. Each organism, whether a producer or consumer, plays a vital role in nutrient cycles and energy flow. If this balance is disrupted, it can lead to the extinction of species and the failure of ecosystems that provide humans with food, clean water, and oxygen.

Humans play a pivotal role in maintaining this balance by ensuring the sustainability of living things. This involves protecting natural habitats from destruction and managing resources responsibly. By implementing conservation strategies, humans can mitigate the negative impacts of urbanization and pollution. Furthermore, practicing a healthy and sustainable lifestyle helps reduce the pressure on natural ecosystems. 

In conclusion, a balanced nature is not just an environmental ideal but a necessity for survival. Through conscious efforts to protect biodiversity and understand our interdependence with the environment, humans can ensure that the planet remains habitable for future generations. Protecting nature is a shared responsibility that guarantees the maintenance and continuity of all life forms.
question.source_excerpt: The role of human in maintaining nature is focused on ensuring the sustainability of living things.
question.illustrative_notes:
Passage: Biodiversity represents the vast variety of organisms that maintain the equilibrium of our planet. Within an ecosystem, every species is linked through a complex web of interdependence, ensuring that nutrient cycles and energy flows remain stable. However, as human industrial activities expand, the role of humans in maintaining nature has become more critical than ever. We must focus on the sustainability of living things to prevent the collapse of these natural systems. 

Question: Why does the writer suggest that human intervention is now 'more critical than ever' for the environment?

marking_rubric_bands.descriptors: Strong content with accurate, well-explained points regarding interdependence and sustainability. Clear structure with introduction, body, and conclusion. Fluent language with minimal errors.
Adequate content with mostly correct explanations of human roles in nature. Generally organised. Some language errors but meaning remains clear.
Limited content with partial or vague explanations of biodiversity. Weak structure. Frequent language errors may affect clarity and coherence.

question.question: Discuss the four levels of friendship based on their characteristics and explain the importance of mutual effort and boundaries in maintaining a harmonious relationship. [10 marks]
question.stimulus: Based on the following information: In modern social circles, many teenagers find it difficult to distinguish between people they merely know and those who truly support their emotional well-being. This confusion often leads to a lack of boundaries or a breakdown in relationships when effort is not reciprocated.
question.model_answer:
Friendship is an essential socialization practice that makes life more meaningful. It evolves through different levels of intimacy based on communication and shared experiences. 

The four levels of friendship include acquaintances, who are individuals we recognize from school or our neighborhood. Next are ordinary friends, who share common interests or goals, such as classmates or teammates. Close friends are those we have known longer, sharing activities like watching movies and visiting each other's homes. Finally, intimate friends are very close individuals who act as pillars of support, with whom we feel comfortable sharing private feelings and opinions.

Maintaining these relationships requires mutual effort and clear boundaries. A friendship will not last if only one party works to maintain the bond. Furthermore, respecting boundaries is crucial for emotional stability. When both friends demonstrate loyalty, trust, and respect, the relationship remains harmonious. In conclusion, understanding the stages of friendship and providing consistent mutual effort ensures a lasting and stable relationship that contributes to a teenager's overall well-being.
question.source_excerpt: Persahabatan wujud dalam pelbagai tahap keakraban iaitu sebagai kenalan, sahabat biasa, sahabat karib dan sahabat intim. Setiap tahap keakraban persahabatan ini mempunyai ciri-cirinya yang tersendiri dan ini merangkumi batasan dan limitasi daripada aspek pergaulan.
question.illustrative_notes: Friendship is a vital socialization process that evolves through communication, progressing from superficial contact to deep intimacy. Students should understand that as communication becomes more open, friendships become closer. The textbook identifies four distinct levels—acquaintances, ordinary friends, close friends, and intimate friends—each with specific characteristics regarding shared activities and emotional depth.

marking_rubric_bands.descriptors: Strong content with accurate, well-explained points regarding all four levels of friendship. Clear structure with introduction, body, and conclusion. Fluent language with minimal errors.
Adequate content with mostly correct explanations of friendship levels and boundaries. Generally organised. Some language errors but meaning is clear.
Limited content with partial or vague explanations of friendship types. Weak structure. Frequent language errors may affect clarity.

question.question: Based on the patterns of friendship, explain the four levels of friendship keakraban (intimacy) and discuss how the level of communication influences the strength of these relationships. [10 marks]
question.stimulus: Based on the following information: Adam is a secondary school student who interacts with many people daily. He has classmates he only talks to about schoolwork, a group he plays football with every weekend, and one specific friend he has known for years and trusts with his personal feelings. These interactions represent different levels of friendship as defined in social psychology.
question.model_answer:
Friendship is a vital socialization process that makes life more meaningful. According to the textbook, there are four levels of friendship based on intimacy. First are acquaintances (kenalan), who are people we recognize and meet frequently at school or in the neighborhood. Second are ordinary friends (sahabat biasa), who share similar interests or goals, such as teammates or classmates. Third are close friends (sahabat karib), individuals we have known for a long time and with whom we share activities like watching movies or eating together. Finally, there are intimate friends (sahabat intim), who serve as pillars in a teenager's life and are those with whom we share deep personal feelings and opinions.

Communication plays a crucial role in these relationships. As communication moves from being closed to more open, the friendship develops from a distant one to a closer bond. In close and intimate friendships, individuals feel comfortable sharing opinions and feelings, which increases trust and loyalty. Maintaining boundaries within these levels is essential because it ensures emotional stability and harmony. In conclusion, understanding these levels allows individuals to navigate social networks effectively, ensuring that the depth of communication matches the level of intimacy for a healthy relationship.
question.source_excerpt: Persahabatan wujud dalam pelbagai tahap keakraban iaitu sebagai kenalan, sahabat biasa, sahabat karib dan sahabat intim. Setiap tahap keakraban persahabatan ini mempunyai ciri-cirinya yang tersendiri dan ini merangkumi batasan dan limitasi daripada aspek pergaulan.
question.illustrative_notes: Students must understand the four distinct levels of friendship: acquaintances, ordinary friends, close friends, and intimate friends. They should also recognize how communication openness and shared activities differentiate these categories according to the PJK Form 3 curriculum.

marking_rubric_bands.descriptors: Excellent description of all four levels of friendship. Provides a clear explanation of the role of communication in strengthening bonds. Well-structured with an introduction, body, and conclusion. Fluent language.
Good description of at least three levels of friendship. Explains communication role adequately. Generally organized but may lack depth in the discussion of emotional stability or boundaries.
Limited content. Mentions some levels of friendship but provides vague or incomplete explanations. Weak structure and frequent language errors that may hinder understanding.

question.question: 请结合上述信息，以“多元文化的魅力”为主题写一篇短文。文中须介绍一个吉隆坡的地标，并说明各族人民共同庆祝节日对促进国民团结的意义。[10分]
question.stimulus: 根据以下信息：在欢庆农历新年之际，阿成收到了朋友金安的祝福邮件。金安强调，尽管大家宗教、习俗和种族不同，但依然团结一致。同时，吉隆坡拥有许多标志性地标，如国油双峰塔和独立广场，这些地方常是各族人民聚集庆祝节日的场所。
question.model_answer:
在马来西亚这个多元文化的国家，节日的意义不仅在于庆祝，更在于体现国民的团结。正如金安在祝贺阿成的邮件中所说，虽然大家的宗教和习俗各异，但我们依然“团结一致”。这种精神在我们的地标建筑中得到了充分体现。

吉隆坡的国油双峰塔是我们的重要地标，它不仅象征着国家的辉煌，也展现了现代马来西亚的魅力。在节日期间，不论是农历新年还是其他庆典，各族人民都会聚集在这些地标下共同欢庆。这种共同庆祝节日的行为具有深远意义。首先，它能促进不同文化背景人民之间的交流与理解，从而消除偏见。其次，共同参与庆典能增强社会的凝聚力，使国民之间的联系更加牢固。最后，这种和谐共处的景象，正是马来西亚最吸引外国友人的地方。我们在欢度佳节的同时，也应注意安全，让这份团结的魅力永远延续下去。
question.source_excerpt: Kami mega ngarapka kaul antara kitai sebakih makin teguh taja pan kitai bebida agama, adat enggau bansa tang kitai tetap segulai sejalai. (我们希望我们之间的友谊更加牢固，虽然我们宗教、习俗和种族不同，但我们依然团结一致。)
question.illustrative_notes: 学生需要结合教材中关于多元文化（宗教、习俗、种族）和谐共处的描述，以及吉隆坡著名地标（如国油双峰塔、独立广场）的相关词汇。重点在于阐述文化融合如何体现国家的“魅力”和“团结”。

marking_rubric_bands.descriptors: 内容充实，准确运用教材中的地标词汇和团结精神。结构清晰，包含引言、内容要点和结尾。语言流利，极少语病。
内容达意，能提及地标和团结的意义。结构尚算完整。语言通顺，虽有少量语病但不影响理解。
内容贫乏或偏离主题，未能有效结合教材信息。结构散乱。语病较多，影响表达。

question.question: Huraikan keunikan warisan sistem pemerintahan Kesultanan Melayu Melaka yang diamalkan di negeri Pahang dan Perak. [10 markah]
question.stimulus: Berdasarkan maklumat berikut: Kesultanan Melayu Melaka telah meninggalkan warisan yang kukuh terhadap sistem pemerintahan di negeri-negeri Melayu yang lain. Kelangsungan tradisi ini dapat dilihat melalui amalan sistem beraja dan struktur pentadbiran yang diamalkan di Pahang dan Perak. Warisan ini menjadi bukti kegemilangan tamadun bangsa Melayu yang diteruskan sehingga hari ini.
question.model_answer:
Kesultanan Melayu Melaka telah mewariskan sistem pemerintahan yang unik kepada negeri Pahang dan Perak. Di kedua-dua negeri ini, Sultan merupakan tonggak utama kerajaan dan penggantian pemerintah adalah berasaskan Adat Temenggung. Di Pahang, sistem pewarisan takhta diamalkan di mana waris ganti digelar Tengku Mahkota. Pelantikan Sultan Pahang juga memerlukan persetujuan daripada Jumaah Pangkuan Diraja Negeri.

Sebaliknya, negeri Perak mengamalkan sistem penggiliran yang unik untuk melantik sultan. Dewan Negara Perak bertanggungjawab memilih dan melantik sultan melalui urutan tertentu, bermula daripada Raja Kecil Bongsu sehingga ke jawatan Sultan. Walaupun terdapat perbezaan dalam kaedah pelantikan, kedua-dua negeri ini mengekalkan Sistem Pembesar Empat Lipatan sebagai asas pentadbiran. Di Pahang, terdapat empat pembesar utama seperti Orang Kaya Indera Shahbandar, manakala di Perak pula terdapat jawatan seperti Orang Kaya Bendahara Seri Maharaja.

Kesimpulannya, warisan sistem pemerintahan ini menunjukkan kebijaksanaan pemerintah dalam mengekalkan kestabilan politik. Kelangsungan sistem ini membuktikan bahawa tradisi Kesultanan Melayu Melaka kekal relevan dan menjadi identiti penting bagi negeri-negeri Melayu tersebut.
question.source_excerpt: Asas pentadbiran Kesultanan Melayu Melaka melalui Sistem Pembesar Empat Lipatan turut diwarisi oleh negeri-negeri ini.
question.illustrative_notes: Murid perlu memahami kesinambungan sistem pentadbiran Kesultanan Melayu Melaka yang diwarisi oleh negeri Pahang dan Perak. Fokus diberikan kepada perbezaan cara pelantikan sultan dan persamaan dalam struktur pembesar.

marking_rubric_bands.descriptors: Isi kandungan yang sangat baik dengan fakta yang tepat seperti sistem pewarisan, sistem penggiliran, dan pembesar empat lipatan. Struktur jawapan jelas dengan pengenalan, huraian isi yang mendalam, dan kesimpulan. Bahasa yang gramatis dan lancar.
Isi kandungan mencukupi dengan penjelasan yang kebanyakannya betul. Organisasi jawapan yang memuaskan. Terdapat beberapa kesalahan bahasa tetapi maksud masih jelas dan mudah difahami.
Isi kandungan terhad dengan penjelasan yang umum atau kurang tepat. Struktur jawapan lemah dan tidak mempunyai kesinambungan yang baik. Kesalahan bahasa yang kerap menjejaskan kejelasan jawapan.
